description: Read the connected user's current, public installation reports for follow-up or correction, and to recognize mods they use. Entries include newerRelease (version, url, publishedAt) or null, and lastFeedbackAt: when they last posted other feedback on that mod, or null. When an installation has a newer release, offer to update and retest, then prepare a fresh report; never retest or publish without the user's go-ahead. Paginate using nextOffset. No other user's private account information is returned.
name: get_my_installations
title: Read your installation reports
